source_row.rationale: Leader rounding — in which nursing leaders regularly visit client rooms and staff work areas — is intended to provide firsthand insight into patient experience and staff needs or concerns, demonstrate visible, accessible leadership presence, and identify opportunities for improvement, recognition, or timely issue resolution, supporting both patient satisfaction and staff engagement.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose and Value of Leader Rounding
